description: Use when an agent must see who is buying or dumping a Base ERC-20 right now (smart-money / whale flow). Input: token address, optional wallet, minutes (1-60), limit. Output: JSON DEX buys vs sells (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, Aerodrome swaps) with netflow, buy/sell ratio, top buyers and sellers, largest swaps, pools; transfer net buyers/sellers tagged contract/EOA/pool/whale; wallet drill-down. On-chain only. Example: ?address=0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on Base mainnet. EOA → 400, non-ERC-20 → 422 (not charged)

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes (default 60). Very busy tokens are cut short; see window.complete

wallet.description: Optional wallet to drill into: its received/sent/net and DEX bought/sold in the window

name: base_token_flows
title: Base smart-money flows: DEX buys vs sells, net buyers/sellers, whales, last 60 min
